item.title: CranioSense: $5.5 Million In Federal Grants Won To Validate Noninvasive Intracranial Pressure Monitoring
item.description: CranioSense, a Massachusetts-based neurotechnology startup developing what it calls the world’s first noninvasive intracranial pressure (ICP) diagnostic and monitoring system, has been awarded approximately $5.5 million in non-dilutive federal grant funding to advance device development and clinical validation ahead of a planned market launch.
